schemas.fire_119_incident:
CREATE TABLE `fire_119_incident` (
  `incident_id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '本地主键，与外部警情ID分开',
  `source_system` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL COMMENT '接入来源标识，测试与生产使用不同标识',
  `external_id` varchar(128) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL COMMENT '接口id，原值保存，区分大小写',
  `order_source` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '接入来源orderSource，当前DIANXIN，非案件类型',
  `region_code` varchar(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'xzqybh，字符串行政区划，不等同街道归属',
  `case_type_code` varchar(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'ajlxdm，当前1火警扑救2抢险救援3社会救助，保留未知代码',
  `case_type_name` varchar(128) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'ajlxmc，接口原始名称',
  `case_status_code` varchar(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'ajztdm，保留原值，不假定状态按数字单调递增',
  `case_status_name` varchar(128) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'ajztmc，接口原始名称，不能由本地字典覆盖',
  `alarm_time` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'lasj，来警时间原墙上时间；源时区待确认',
  `address` text COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci COMMENT 'afdz，案发地址；不要求属于已有监管机构',
  `description` text COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci COMMENT 'ajms，警情描述，可能含个人信息',
  `case_nature_code` varchar(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'ajxz，统一转字符串；0虚警1实警2测试，保留未知代码',
  `case_nature_name` varchar(128) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'ajxzmc，原始名称',
  `merge_status_code` varchar(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'hbzt，统一转字符串；0已合并1未合并，不据此猜测合并目标',
  `merge_status_name` varchar(128) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'hbztmc，原始名称',
  `case_level_code` varchar(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'temp_ajdjdm，统一转字符串，非本地排序等级',
  `case_level_name` varchar(128) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'temp_ajdjdmmc，原始名称',
  `source_longitude` decimal(12,8) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'jd校验后的源经度，保留8位小数；非法值留空并保留原文',
  `source_latitude` decimal(12,8) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'wd校验后的源纬度，保留8位小数',
  `source_coord_system` varchar(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown' COMMENT 'unknown/GCJ02/WGS84/BD09，必须确认后标识',
  `map_longitude` decimal(12,8) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '经确认或转换后的高德GCJ02经度，未确认不得直接填源坐标',
  `map_latitude` decimal(12,8) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '高德GCJ02纬度',
  `coordinate_status` varchar(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' COMMENT 'pending待确认/valid可展示/invalid非法/missing缺失',
  `street_name` varchar(128) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '经核验的所属街道，不能由请求的区级编码直接赋值',
  `street_match_status` varchar(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' COMMENT 'pending待判定/inside大厂街道内/outside街道外',
  `street_match_method` varchar(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '归属判定方法，如official/manual/boundary，不能只靠地址关键词',
  `street_match_basis` varchar(1000) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '判定依据、行政边界版本或人工核验说明',
  `street_checked_by` bigint DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '核验用户，逻辑关联sys_user',
  `street_checked_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '街道归属核验时间',
  `place_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '可选关联fire_place，不匹配时留空，不自动新建机构',
  `dept_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '本平台数据权限归属，逻辑关联sys_dept，不从区划编码猜测',
  `supervisor_user_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '本平台负责人，逻辑关联sys_user',
  `source_sjc` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'sjc原墙上时间；字段业务含义、时区及增量语义待确认',
  `source_create_time_utc` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'create_time按显式时区解析后转UTC，不能覆盖本地create_time',
  `source_njs_create_time_utc` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'njs_create_time按显式时区解析后转UTC',
  `source_njs_update_time_utc` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'njs_update_time按显式时区解析后转UTC，未确认可作增量游标',
  `source_sugon_create_time_utc` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'sugon_create_time按显式时区解析后转UTC',
  `source_sugon_update_time_utc` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'sugon_update_time按显式时区解析后转UTC，未确认可作增量游标',
  `source_manually_add` tinyint DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'manually_add，JSON布尔转0/1；不据此推断本地人工操作',
  `source_counterfeit` tinyint DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'counterfeit原布尔标记，含义待确认，不能替代ajxz',
  `source_flag` int DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'flag原整数，含义待确认，不用于过滤或删除',
  `source_manual_operate_count` bigint DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'manual_operate_count原值，含义待确认',
  `raw_json` json NOT NULL COMMENT '该条警情完整原始JSON，保留源类型、原始时间字符串和未知字段',
  `payload_hash` char(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL COMMENT '源记录规范化后SHA256，不含本地时间和归属字段',
  `revision_no` bigint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '1' COMMENT '本地观察版本，源内容变化才增加',
  `first_synced_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL COMMENT '首次成功落库时间，本地Asia/Shanghai',
  `last_seen_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL COMMENT '最近一次接口返回该记录的时间；内容不变仍更新',
  `last_changed_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL COMMENT '最近观察到源内容变化时间，不是外部实际变更时间',
  `last_sync_batch_id` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '最近获取批次，逻辑关联同步日志',
  `create_by` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT '' COMMENT '创建者或同步服务标识',
  `create_time` datetime(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) COMMENT '本地创建时间，Asia/Shanghai',
  `update_by` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT '' COMMENT '本地更新者',
  `update_time` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '本地更新时间，Asia/Shanghai',
  `remark` varchar(500) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '本地备注，源同步不覆盖',
  `geofence_status` varchar(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' COMMENT '纯几何范围pending/inside/outside',
  `geofence_version` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT '' COMMENT '源坐标系和转换边界版本',
  `boundary_distance_m` decimal(12,3) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '距边界米数，仅提示复核',
  PRIMARY KEY (`incident_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_119_incident_source` (`source_system`,`external_id`),
  KEY `idx_119_incident_street_time` (`street_match_status`,`alarm_time`,`incident_id`),
  KEY `idx_119_incident_region_time` (`source_system`,`region_code`,`alarm_time`,`incident_id`),
  KEY `idx_119_incident_type_time` (`case_type_code`,`alarm_time`,`incident_id`),
  KEY `idx_119_incident_status_time` (`case_status_code`,`alarm_time`,`incident_id`),
  KEY `idx_119_incident_dept_time` (`dept_id`,`alarm_time`,`incident_id`),
  KEY `idx_119_incident_supervisor` (`supervisor_user_id`,`alarm_time`),
  KEY `idx_119_incident_place` (`place_id`),
  KEY `idx_119_geofence` (`source_system`,`geofence_version`,`geofence_status`,`alarm_time`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=5484 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci ROW_FORMAT=DYNAMIC COMMENT='119警情当前快照，全部案件类型，街道归属与坐标需核验'
schemas.fire_alarm_simulation:

  `request_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,

  `place_name` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `address` varchar(500) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT '',

  `longitude` decimal(12,8) NOT NULL,
  `latitude` decimal(12,8) NOT NULL,
  `occurred_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `dept_id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `supervisor_user_id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `create_by` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL,

schemas.fire_gateway:

schemas.fire_inspection_post:

schemas.fire_inspection_record:

schemas.fire_place:
CREATE TABLE `fire_place` (
  `place_id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '监管场所ID',
  `source_key` char(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '初始导入来源SHA256，手工新增可空',
  `name` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '企业、机构或小区名称',
  `place_type` varchar(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '字典fire_place_type的dict_value',
  `industry_category` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '原表行业类别',
  `management_company` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '物业或管理单位',
  `credit_code` varchar(18) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '经营主体统一社会信用代码，非场所唯一标识',
  `dept_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '监管归属部门，逻辑关联sys_dept',
  `supervisor_user_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '监管人员，逻辑关联sys_user',
  `community_name` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '所属社区',
  `grid_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '真实业务网格，后续接入',
  `address` varchar(500) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '原始地址',
  `normalized_address` varchar(500) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '核实补全后的定位地址',
  `adcode` varchar(12) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '行政区划代码',
  `main_risk_sources` text COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci COMMENT '原表主要风险源',
  `risk_level` varchar(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '后续评估风险等级，不从风险源猜测',
  `employee_count` int unsigned DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '原表企业人数，非居民人数',
  `building_area_m2` decimal(14,2) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '建筑面积，原数值按平方米，待业务核实单位',
  `resident_elderly_count` int unsigned DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '居住老人数',
  `disabled_elderly_count` int unsigned DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '失能老人数',
  `highrise_building_count` int unsigned DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '高层建筑楼栋数',
  `passenger_flow_raw` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '客流量原文，周期尚未明确',
  `mini_fire_station_equipment` text COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci COMMENT '微型消防站器材原文',
  `emergency_team_count` int unsigned DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '应急消防队伍人数',
  `longitude` decimal(10,7) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'GCJ02经度，未知留空',
  `latitude` decimal(10,7) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'GCJ02纬度，未知留空',
  `coordinate_system` varchar(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'GCJ02' COMMENT '地图输出坐标系',
  `coordinate_source` varchar(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'amap_geocode/manual/imported',
  `location_status` varchar(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' COMMENT '字典fire_location_status',
  `matched_address` varchar(500) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '地址解析匹配结果',
  `amap_poi_id` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '高德POI标识',
  `location_checked_by` bigint DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '核验人员，逻辑关联sys_user',
  `location_checked_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '坐标核验时间',
  `status` char(1) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '状态（0正常 1停用）',
  `del_flag` char(1) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '删除标志（0存在 2删除）',
  `create_by` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT '' COMMENT '创建者',
  `create_time` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '创建时间',
  `update_by` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT '' COMMENT '更新者',
  `update_time` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '更新时间',
  `remark` varchar(500) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '备注',
  `revision` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '资料版本，防止覆盖并发修改',
  PRIMARY KEY (`place_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_fire_place_source` (`source_key`),
  KEY `idx_fire_place_filter` (`place_type`,`del_flag`,`status`,`location_status`),
  KEY `idx_fire_place_dept` (`dept_id`),
  KEY `idx_fire_place_supervisor` (`supervisor_user_id`),
  KEY `idx_fire_place_grid` (`grid_id`),
  KEY `idx_fire_place_name` (`name`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=340 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci COMMENT='消防监管场所'
schemas.fire_place_contact:
CREATE TABLE `fire_place_contact` (
  `contact_id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '联系人记录ID',
  `place_id` bigint NOT NULL COMMENT '场所ID',
  `contact_role` varchar(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '字典fire_contact_role',
  `contact_name` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '联系人姓名',
  `phone` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '联系电话，字符串保存',
  `sort_order` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '同角色联系人排序',
  `status` char(1) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '状态（0正常 1停用）',
  `del_flag` char(1) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '删除标志（0存在 2删除）',
  `create_by` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT '' COMMENT '创建者',
  `create_time` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '创建时间',
  `update_by` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT '' COMMENT '更新者',
  `update_time` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '更新时间',
  `remark` varchar(500) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '备注',
  PRIMARY KEY (`contact_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_fire_contact_role` (`place_id`,`contact_role`,`sort_order`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_fire_contact_place` FOREIGN KEY (`place_id`) REFERENCES `fire_place` (`place_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=442 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci COMMENT='场所联系人，非登录账号'
schemas.fire_place_import_row:
CREATE TABLE `fire_place_import_row` (
  `import_row_id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '来源记录ID',
  `source_key` char(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '文件哈希、工作表、行号计算的SHA256',
  `batch_no` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '导入批次',
  `file_name` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '原始文件名',
  `file_sha256` char(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '原始文件内容SHA256',
  `sheet_name` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '原始工作表',
  `row_number` int unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Excel实际行号',
  `source_serial` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '原始序号',
  `raw_data` json NOT NULL COMMENT '按列号保存标题、表头、原值，保留重复列名',
  `place_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '关联场所',
  `import_status` varchar(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' COMMENT 'pending/imported/review/rejected',
  `error_message` text COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci COMMENT '数据处理说明',
  `create_by` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT '' COMMENT '导入人',
  `create_time` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '导入时间',
